title: The Blind Curator: How a Biased Judge Silently Disables Skill Retirement in Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.07436v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A self-evolving agent retires its bad skills by watching them fail, so what happens when the judge cannot see the failures? Skill retirement is the structural constraint that keeps a growing library from drifting below the no-skill baseline, but its guarantee assumes an unbiased reward, which is false for the LLM judges that reference-free tasks require. We show that a biased judge does not merely add noise; it \emph{silently switches off the curator}. We make this precise with a corrupted-reward analysis, then a behavioral study on a reference-free report-writing testbed with a code-generation cross-check, injecting corruption on top of a deterministic reward to isolate the causal channel. Symmetric noise leaves retirement intact, but \emph{false-pass} bias (failures slipping through as passes) disables contribution-based retirement past a sharp threshold (here a false-pass rate of $0.45$) that no amount of data can cross. translated_title: 盲目的策展人：有偏见的评判者如何悄然禁用自进化代理中的技能淘汰机制
translated_abstract: 一个自进化代理通过观察技能失败来淘汰其不良技能，那么当评判者无法看到失败时会发生什么？技能淘汰是保持不断增长的技能库不跌至无技能基线之下的结构性约束，但其保证假设了一个无偏的奖励，这对于无参考任务所需的LLM评判者来说是不成立的。我们表明，有偏见的评判者不仅会添加噪声；它还会“悄然关闭策展人”。我们通过一个损坏奖励分析来精确说明这一点，然后在无参考报告撰写测试平台上进行行为研究，并辅以代码生成交叉检查，在确定性奖励之上注入损坏以隔离因果通道。对称噪声不会影响淘汰机制，但“假通过”偏差（失败被误判为通过）会在一个尖锐阈值（此处为假通过率0.45）之后禁用基于贡献的淘汰，且任何数量的数据都无法跨越该阈值。
tldr: 本文揭示了自进化代理中，评判者的“假通过”偏差会超过一个阈值（如假通过率0.45）悄然禁用技能淘汰机制，导致系统性能无法恢复，而对称噪声则无此影响。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that false-pass bias in a judge silently disables skill retirement in self-evolving agents past a sharp threshold (e.g., false-pass rate 0.45), causing unrecoverable performance decline, while symmetric noise does not.
